review_notes: I read the whole 82-line file. It has two short integrability lemmas and one integration-by-parts theorem. The integrability lemmas are a thin wrapper around `Lp.memLp` and a one-time conversion from the open interval to the interval integral. The main proof is a single application of the existing lemma `inner_sub_inner_eq_integral_of_gelfandDual`, followed by simp and linarith. None of these proofs repeats nontrivial reasoning. I grepped the repository for the `intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioo_of_le` pattern. The other uses are short and in unrelated contexts. They do not combine it with the `uIcc` subset argument in a way that would justify a shared lemma. Under the rubric, a shared helper here would be a thin wrapper, so I report no finding.
